user.title: Connect to Hydrolix
user.description:
Enter the ingest URL of your table and an ingest token. Create the project and table in the Hydrolix console first.

URL format: `{example_url}`

The transform is optional: without one, Schema Intelligence (Autopilot) accepts every event by default and promotes fields once it has seen enough data.

data_description.ingest_url: Full ingest URL with table=project.table. Add &transform=name to use a specific transform.
data_description.hydrolix_token: Service-account token with ingest permission on the project or table

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Hydrolix cluster. Check the URL and that your IP is allowlisted.
error.invalid_url: Enter the full ingest URL, in the format shown above.
error.invalid_table: The URL needs table=project.table. Use letters, digits and underscores only.
error.invalid_transform: The transform name in the URL is not valid.

abort.already_configured: This Hydrolix project + table combination is already configured.

data_description.batch_size: Number of events to send per batch (1–10000)
data_description.batch_interval: How often to flush the event queue in seconds (1–300)
data_description.include_domains: Only record these domains (comma-separated, e.g., sensor, climate)
data_description.exclude_domains: Never record these domains (comma-separated, e.g., automation, script)
data_description.include_device_classes: Only record entities with these device classes (e.g., temperature, humidity)
data_description.exclude_device_classes: Never record entities with these device classes (e.g., motion, battery)
